channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: Global outage hits Cloudflare again, disrupting major websites
item.description: This marks Cloudflare's second disruption in less than a month. A similar technical issue in November had temporarily knocked out a range of services, including Spotify, ChatGPT, and US President Donald Trump's Truth Social platform.

item.title: Sensex, Nifty rise after RBI cuts repo rate
item.description: Along with the rate cut, the RBI sharply lowered its inflation forecast for FY26 to 2 per cent from 2.6 per cent and increased its growth projection to 7.3 per cent from 6.8 per cent earlier. Following the announcement, the Sensex closed at 85,712.37, rising 447.05 points or 0.52 per cent.

item.title: Airfares skyrocket across India amid IndiGo's massive disruptions
item.description: The sudden grounding created an immediate shortage of seats, triggering a sharp rise in last-minute ticket prices across the country. Delhi Airport announced the suspension on its official X handle, confirming that all IndiGo domestic flights scheduled to depart on December 5 would remain cancelled until 11:59 p.m.

item.title: Grounded dreams: IndiGo meltdown and India's aviation reckoning
item.description: This crisis is India's clearest burning platform in civil aviation history. If seized with rigour and political will, December 2025 will be remembered not as the week the skies failed, but as the moment India built an aviation ecosystem that is safe, resilient, competitive, and genuinely passenger-first.

item.title: Lok Sabha passes 'Health Security Se National Security Cess Bill' amid debate
item.description: Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman, piloting the legislation, clarified that the proceeds of the cess would be strictly ring-fenced for two purposes; strengthening India's national security and supporting public health.

item.title: Centre orders high-level inquiry into IndiGo fiasco, total normalcy expected in 3 days
item.description: As thousands of passengers faced harrowing time at airports across the country, Civil Aviation Minister Ram Mohan Naidu said in a statement that "we expect that flight schedules will begin to stabilise and return to normal by tomorrow. We anticipate that complete restoration of services will be achieved within the next three days".

item.title: 'If I lied, I'll quit': Shivakumar dares BJP's Narayanaswamy in luxury-watch row
item.description: Karnataka Deputy CM D.K. Shivakumar escalated the luxury-watch row, challenging BJP's Narayanaswamy to resign if any of his disclosures are proven false. He said he has submitted all watch details to the Lokayukta and accused the BJP leader of making baseless allegations.

item.title: Foxconn's China exit due to erratic policies, signals MNCs shift to India, Vietnam
item.description: Apple, wary of Beijing's tightening grip and erratic policies, accelerated its relocation strategy, pulling Foxconn's capacity along with it. India and Vietnam, offering tax incentives and policy stability, became attractive alternatives.

item.title: Apple announces 2025 app store award winners
item.description: The winners were chosen from 45 finalists by App Store editors. Apple CEO Tim Cook said the award-winning apps and games show how developers across the world continue to push boundaries and make products that enrich people's lives.

item.title: BB 19 finale week: Pranit cries after Malti leaves without hugging him; Gaurav mocks Farrahana; BB trophy revealed
item.description: Ahead of the grand finale, huge drama unfolded at BB house, with Gaurav mocking Farrhana, discussing her boyfriends, and linking her with contestants, as Malti was before eviction, and also abusing Pranit. The winner will be announced on December 7, 2025.
